description: Full required BWB aero-surrogate trust chain: dataset, aero, QC, curation, promotion, EDA, ML, model promotion, and inference guard.
name: rehearsal_n5

stages.description: Generate and inspect the geometry design-space dataset.
stages.name: geometry_dataset

stages.description: Run a controlled single-geometry aero sweep to verify solver setup, flight-condition ranges, controls, and raw artifacts.
stages.name: aero_sweep

stages.description: Generate the unified aero-labeled dataset from geometry and flight-condition sweeps.
stages.name: aero_dataset
stages.recommended_command: aeris dataset aero-generate -c configs/geometry/bwb_training_v1.yaml --n <N> --qc-preset production --retain-aero-runs failures_only --workflow <workflow_root>

stages.description: Run post-hoc aero QC and confirm row/artifact consistency.
stages.name: dataset_qc

stages.description: Promote the curated dataset so ML can use it.
stages.name: promotion

stages.description: Audit promoted data before training using EDA and feature-set checks.
stages.name: ml_eda
stages.recommended_command: aeris ml eda --dataset data/datasets/<promoted_dataset> --feature-set bwb_control_physics_v1 --targets cl,cd,cm --no-plots

stages.description: Train baseline model(s) from promoted data with grouped split.
stages.name: ml_training
stages.recommended_command: aeris ml train --dataset data/datasets/<promoted_dataset> --feature-set bwb_control_raw --targets cl,cd,cm --model-type extra_trees --split-method grouped --group-column geometry_id

stages.description: Compare candidate model families and/or split seeds.
stages.name: model_comparison
stages.recommended_command: aeris ml compare-seeds --dataset data/datasets/<promoted_dataset> --feature-set bwb_control_raw --targets cl,cd,cm --models extra_trees,gradient_boosting,hist_gradient_boosting --split-method grouped --group-column geometry_id

stages.description: Promote the selected model using reviewed target-aware gates.
stages.name: model_promotion
stages.recommended_command: aeris ml suggest-promotion-gates --model-run-dir data/processed/ml_runs/<run> && aeris ml promote-model --model-run-dir data/processed/ml_runs/<run> --gate-config <template.yaml>

stages.description: Check prediction inputs against the promoted model and training envelope.
stages.name: inference_guard

stages.description: Optional LF/HF delta dataset, delta model, corrected prediction, and evaluation.
stages.name: multifidelity
stages.recommended_command: aeris ml build-delta-dataset ... && aeris ml train-delta-model ... && aeris ml evaluate-delta-model ...

stages.description: Optional candidate ranking for the next solver batch.
stages.name: active_learning

stages.description: Collect promoted model/package evidence for future MDAO or reporting.
stages.name: final_package

template.description: Full required BWB aero-surrogate trust chain: dataset, aero, QC, curation, promotion, EDA, ML, model promotion, and inference guard.
template.name: production
notes: Use grouped ML splits by geometry_id.
Do not train on raw or curated-only datasets; use promoted datasets.
template.title: Production training workflow
